IpToUserId_Description: Map IP addresses to custom user identifiers. When a visitor accesses your site from a mapped IP, they will automatically be assigned the configured user ID.
IpToUserId_BulkImportHelp: Enter one mapping per line in the format: IP,UserID (supports CIDR notation for ranges)
IpToUserId_NoMappings: No IP to User ID mappings have been configured yet.
IpToUserId_DeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this mapping?
IpToUserId_FillAllFields: Please fill in both IP address and user identifier.
